description: Bootstrap the newly-split lugh repo (the private fine-tuning platform) into a clean standalone package: uv workspace, real CI/verify, and a README establishing it as lugh:agent:finetune. Runs in the lugh repo after pinakes extracts it. See pinakes docs/LUGH-EXTRACTION-PLAN.md.
verify: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider

userStories.title: Standalone uv workspace + CI
userStories.description: Make lugh a self-contained repo: root pyproject/uv workspace, ruff + pytest gates, and a verify.sh that provisions the dev extra (the missing-pytest gap from the pinakes flatten).
acceptanceCriteria: Root pyproject/uv workspace builds; `uv sync --extra dev` installs torch/pykeen/trl-optional + pytest + ruff.
.chief/verify.sh runs `uv sync --extra dev` then `uv run python -m pytest` + `uv run ruff check`, and exits non-zero on failure.
A CI workflow runs the same gates on push.
The full suite collects and the fixture-only (CI-safe) tests pass; live-corpus tests skipif the corpus is absent.

userStories.title: README + identity
userStories.description: Document lugh as the specialized local-only KFT fine-tuning provider lugh:agent:finetune, and its relationship to koine (contract), agora (general trainer), cuneiform (control plane), and pinakes (corpus producer).

A CLAUDE.md (ported/trimmed from the old ml/CLAUDE.md) documents the workspace's gates and the neurosymbolic + SLM + KFT surfaces.
